invention.ref: Scholar-official Yan Zhitui mentions using paper for toilet purposes (c. 589)
invention.ref_zh: 学者颜之推（约 589 年）提到用纸如厕

patent.ref: Seth Wheeler of Albany, NY: earliest US toilet-paper and dispenser patents
patent.ref_zh: 奥尔巴尼的惠勒获美国最早的卫生纸与纸架专利

mass_production.ref: Ming court at Nanjing receives 720,000 sheets a year
mass_production.ref_zh: 明朝南京宫廷每年供应 72 万张手纸

popularization.ref: Joseph Gayetty's Medicated Paper, first modern commercial toilet paper in the US
popularization.ref_zh: 盖耶蒂推出「药用纸」，美国最早的现代商品卫生纸

locations.place_label_zh: 中国（隋唐时期，以长安示意）
美国纽约州奥尔巴尼（惠勒）

notes: 颜之推的记载只说明当时已有人用纸如厕；地点以隋唐都城长安示意。盖耶蒂的城市未经核实，只标到国家。
summary_zh: 约 589 年颜之推已提到用纸如厕；14 世纪中国已大量生产手纸；1857 年美国出现商品卫生纸，1883 年惠勒获得卷筒纸架专利。
summary_en: Yan Zhitui mentioned toilet paper around 589; China mass-produced it by the 14th century. Gayetty sold commercial toilet paper in the US in 1857, and Wheeler patented rolls and dispensers in 1883.
summary_ja: 顔之推は589年頃にトイレットペーパーに言及し、中国は14世紀までに量産した。Gayetty は1857年に米国で商品を売り、Wheeler は1883年にロールとディスペンサーを特許化した。

image.alt_en: A roll of white toilet paper

notes_en: Yan Zhitui's remark only shows paper was already used this way; Chang'an marks the Sui–Tang capital as an approximation. Gayetty's city is unverified, so it is country-level.
